title: Where do birds belong?
hook: A family tree can include living and extinct branches.

doesNotKnow: Birds are living dinosaurs. Triceratops and Tyrannosaurus rex are non-avian dinosaurs; neither is an ancestor of living birds. Crocodilians lie outside Dinosauria.

misconception: All dinosaurs disappeared without living descendants.
objective: Place living birds within the dinosaur lineage.

claims.text: On a family tree, where do living birds belong relative to dinosaurs? Birds are living dinosaurs. Triceratops and Tyrannosaurus rex are non-avian dinosaurs; neither is an ancestor of living birds. Crocodilians lie outside Dinosauria.
